item.title: Digging into Drama at the Document Foundation
item.description:
📝 TDF has revoked foundation membership status from about 30 people who work for or have contracting status with Collabora. The trustees elect the membership committee and board of directors; the membership committee oversees membership applications and renewals, as well as the board of directors elections. Public discussion A blog post by Italo Vignoli, in response to Collabora's announcement, acknowledged that TDF had revoked membership from those affiliated with Collabora.
🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1066418/

item.title: Mojo 1.0 Beta
item.description:
📝 Your Mojo code imports naturally into Python and packages together for distribution. Likewise, you can import libraries from the Python ecosystem into your Mojo code. Mojo natively interoperates with Python so you can eliminate performance bottlenecks in existing code without rewriting everything.
🔗 Read more: https://mojolang.org/
